question: Which of the following mountains is located near the river Dhauliganga?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nanda Devi.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nanda Devi ****mountains** are located near the river **Dhauliganga.**
 
• It is located in **Chamoli Garhwal** district of Uttarakhand, between the Rishiganga valley on the west and the Goriganga valley on the east.
 
• The peak, whose name means **"Bliss-Giving Goddess"**, is regarded as the patron goddess of the Garhwal and Kumaon Himalayas.
 
• It is India's second-highest mountain which is approached through the Rishi Ganga gorge, one of the deepest in the world.
 
• The peak of the Nanda Devi is located at a height of **7816m.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Mountain Peak**
 **Description**
 
 

 Kamet
 
 
It is the second-highest mountain in the Garhwal region of Uttarakhand, India, after Nanda Devi.

 
It has an elevation of **7756 m**.

 
 
 

 Anamudi
 
 
It is the highest peak in the Western Ghats and in South India.

 
It has an elevation of **2,695 meters.**

 
 
 

 Hathi Parvat
 
 
Hathi Parvat sometimes called the 'Elephant Peak' is a prominent peak in the Badrinath region of the Chamoli district.

 
It has an elevation of **6727 m.**
